domain: employment, public service, visas, labor-condition filings, workforce programs, unions, layoffs, payroll, and personnel mobility
scope: Employer and occupational denominators, H-1B and labor-condition filings, permanent-labor certifications, public payroll and appointments, union and labor-organization filings, workforce grants, WARN notices, layoffs, hiring, job classifications, and personnel transitions. The estate separates authorized position, filing, employment, appointment, compensation, and later role.
why_new_estate: Person-router, ethics, defense, AI, research, and development trails repeatedly reach employment and immigration systems that existing estates do not own.

denominator_contract.unit: one employer-position-filing, appointment, payroll record, labor organization filing, WARN event, or documented personnel transition
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Official aggregate and case-level labor disclosures, employer filings, public payroll, appointment records, union reports, workforce awards, and layoff notices.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Aggregate employer filings attributed to a person; resume text without official corroboration; job posting as filled position.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: employer present with zero filing in bounded dataset
layoff notice with no identified affected legal entity

source_routes.authority: U.S. Department of Labor Office of Foreign Labor Certification
source_routes.bounded_output: Quarterly and annual employer application disclosure data for H-1B/LCA, PERM, H-2 and related programs with case, employer, occupation, location, wage, and disposition fields.
source_routes.residual_fog: Applications do not identify every worker or prove employment; employer names, work sites, amendments, withdrawals, and case status require normalization.

source_routes.bounded_output: Employer-level H-1B petition approvals and denials by fiscal year and employer with industry and location fields.
source_routes.residual_fog: Aggregate employer data does not identify beneficiaries, exact jobs, work sites, or continued employment.

source_routes.bounded_output: Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification notices and state-published layoff or closure lists with employer, site, date, and affected-worker counts where available.
source_routes.residual_fog: State publication practices vary; notice does not establish final layoffs, cause, legal compliance, or entity identity without exact site and employer resolution.

source_routes.authority: United States and United Kingdom public bodies
source_routes.bounded_output: Public payroll, appointment, position, compensation, term, and organization records where legally public.
source_routes.residual_fog: Coverage and privacy rules vary; payroll presence, appointment authority, detail, contractor work, and later employment are distinct.

source_routes.authority: U.S. Department of Labor Office of Labor-Management Standards
source_routes.bounded_output: Labor-organization, officer, financial, trustee, employer-consultant, and labor-relations consultant filings.
source_routes.residual_fog: Filed reports have statutory scope and thresholds; membership, bargaining unit, employer, and individual identity require exact joins.

source_routes.authority: United States state labor agencies and boards
source_routes.bounded_output: State labor-board decisions, wage enforcement, unemployment, workforce, occupational, and employer records where public.
source_routes.residual_fog: No single national system exists; adjudication, employer identity, and historical coverage vary.

source_routes.bounded_output: Award and transaction identifiers with separate ceiling, obligation, and outlay fields.
source_routes.residual_fog: Recipient identity, award hierarchy, subaward coverage, and performance reconciliation remain estate-specific.

source_routes.route_label: USCIS EB-5 regional centers and program records
source_routes.bounded_output: EB-5 program guidance, approved regional centers, terminations, compliance notices, and publicly available project or offering-related program records.
source_routes.residual_fog: Individual petitions and much project-level adjudication are protected; regional-center status does not establish a project investment, approval, success, or investor identity.

decisive_output: employer- and position-level workforce ledger with filing, occupation, location, dates, compensation, appointment, separation, and explicit aggregate or no-match limits
next_acquisition: join exact employers, positions, filings, payroll, appointments, layoffs, unions, and personnel transitions while retaining aggregate-only limits
boundaries: A visa or labor filing is not proof a named person worked in a position. Employment sequence, public service, and later corporate role do not establish knowledge transfer or influence.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
